changelog: Orion 3.4 — one fix: live voice matching. Orion now compares voices it hears through its own recorder against your voice print, on your phone. Record at least 3 samples of your voice in Voice & Face → Your Voice and Orion builds your print from them. From then on: a voice that matches your print runs as you; an unsure one stops and asks 'Casey, was that you?' and runs only if you say yes; a voice that doesn't match is never run as you. The print is a helper, not a lock — it never blocks you from your own app, typing is never gated, and forgetting your samples deletes the print with them. One honest limit: the phone's built-in speech recognizer gives the app no audio to compare, so on that path Orion says there was nothing to compare instead of pretending. New Terms section 6U states all of this — the app will ask you to agree again, once.
